description: This file defines the code-behind logic for the TheorySet page in an online examination system. It includes event handlers for loading the page, button clicks for navigation, course and semester selection, adding questions, and setting exam details. It interacts with a SQL database to manage question sets and course exams, and controls UI elements like dropdowns and textboxes.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the TheorySet ASP.NET WebForm, managing question and course setup for the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; currently contains only commented code.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new question set to the database, updates question number, and provides user feedback.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Records a new exam detail entry into the database and navigates to admin panel.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Populates course dropdown based on selected semester.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Calculates and updates the question number based on selected course.
